visual_review: Girl's head with double hair buns as one outline mirrored about x=24: two r6 buns (their inner quarters hidden behind the head, as in the reference) on a domed crown, rounded face down to the chin, and bangs with a centre parting. Human reference checked: a head silhouette, so there are no detached-head flags. Risk: without ears and shoulders it can read as a teddy-bear head.
omissions: The ears and the shoulder lines are omitted: ears would have to protrude past the buns, and shoulders have no 8-unit room below the chin. Full bun rings read as frog eyes, so their inner quarters are hidden.
